name: digital-clay
description: Hand-tracked SDF clay sculpting prototype for Meta Quest 3 (WebXR)

scripts.headset:bridge: tools/platform-tools/adb reverse tcp:8080 tcp:8080 && echo bridged
scripts.headset:open: tools/platform-tools/adb shell am start -a android.intent.action.VIEW -d http://localhost:8080
scripts.headset:shot: tools/platform-tools/adb exec-out screencap -p > headset.png && echo wrote headset.png
